pages.title: Ritual Brazier
pages.text: Ritual Braziers hold offerings for $(l:hexalia:core_mechanics/natures_ritual)Nature Rituals and Summoning$(/l), and for $(l:hexalia:core_mechanics/celestial_infusion)Celestial Rituals$(/l). Crouch and use an $(l:hexalia:content/tools#athame)Athame$(/l) on planks to make one.

pages.title: Preparation
pages.text: Put one offering in each participating Brazier, even for repeated ingredients, then add Salt or another compatible salt. The offering and salt are consumed during the ritual; the Brazier itself is not. See the $(l:hexalia:core_mechanics/natures_ritual#structure)shared ritual setup$(/l).
